gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-almendra: Almendra reads dignified and bookish, its lowercase carrying a deep midsection that gives each word weight. And Nasalization brings blueprint-style lettering of constant line, so drafting table meets old library.

gen-dafont-neon-outfit: Neon glows with uninterrupted line width and stamped-metal lowercase forms that stand high. But Outfit bends its curves like cable, stopping well short of closing, which leaves Neon free to be the big, brief voice.

gen-dafont-neon-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads neutral and geometric, with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Neon supplies the glow up top, while Space Grotesk handles the quieter reading.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads professional and clean, its s curves opening wide at both ends, against the slim, closed letters of Neuropol. Fira Sans has zero stroke contrast and a larger-than-usual x-height, so extended text stays comfortable.
